description: Discover/select a LOCAL device. Ask for platform if unknown; one device is auto-selected. For multiple devices, ask the user to choose, then pass deviceUdid. Next: prepare_ios_simulator for iOS simulators, then appium_session_management action=create. Skip for REMOTE servers: pass device capabilities (appium:deviceName/appium:udid) and the user-provided remoteServerUrl to session creation.

deviceUdid.description: User-selected UDID. Omit to discover devices.

iosDeviceType.description: Required for ios: simulator or real device.

name: select_device
